title.zh-CN: Litz 线分层建模与数值验证：完整研究报告
title.en: Litz-Wire Modeling and Numerical Verification: Comprehensive Research Report

abstract.zh-CN:
Litz 线的高频损耗取决于单股趋肤、局部邻近场、股间复电流分配、换位路径及端部约束。本文建立可复现的分层数值验证框架，区分各层实际保留的物理内容。沿途绝缘、端部并联的股线采用共同端电压和总复电流约束，并在指定线性场路模型内给出均流判据。有限长度纵向 PEEC 则独立检查轴向长度、互项与自项积分及横向离散的影响。

在 200 kHz、20 A RMS、20 ℃ 铜导体工况下，单圆线解析与独立二维校准建立了内场参考，640 股二维共端模型具有受控网格、回流和外域检查。5024 自由度纵向模型末档 Rac 为 20.012738 mΩ/轴向m，与本档等面积 Bessel 参照相差 0.044582%。固定长方体外场 RT0 算例的末两次损耗变化为 0.655090% 和 0.362916%；它检验外场算子，不能作为 Litz 输运电阻。三维 A–φ、Ansys 新接口及真实性能排名的未通过边界继续保留。结果支持限定模型内的数值结论，不证明实际多级或跨层 Litz 的性能优劣。
abstract.en:
High-frequency loss in Litz wire depends on strand skin effect, local proximity fields, complex current sharing, transposition paths, and terminal constraints. This study establishes a reproducible hierarchy of numerical verification in which the physical content retained by each model is stated explicitly. Individually insulated strands connected in parallel are described by a common terminal voltage and a total complex-current constraint, yielding a current-sharing criterion within a specified linear field–circuit model. Finite-length longitudinal PEEC is then examined through independent changes in axial length, mutual and self integration, and cross-sectional discretization.

For copper at 200 kHz, 20 A RMS, and 20 °C, the round-wire analytical solution and independent two-dimensional calibration establish an internal-field reference. The 640-strand common-terminal model has controlled mesh, return, and exterior-boundary checks. The final 5024-degree-of-freedom longitudinal model gives an axial resistance of 20.012738 mΩ/m, differing by 0.044582% from its equal-area Bessel reference. The final two loss changes in the fixed-cuboid imposed-field RT0 example are 0.655090% and 0.362916%; this example tests an imposed-field operator and does not measure Litz transport resistance. Unsuccessful three-dimensional A–φ validation, new Ansys interfaces, and unresolved realistic-geometry ranking remain explicit boundaries. These results support numerical conclusions within stated models, without establishing the superiority of actual multilevel or cross-layer Litz structures.

abstract.zh-CN: Litz 线高频损耗受单股趋肤、股间耦合与端接约束共同影响。本文建立解析圆线、二维共端场路和有限长度纵向 PEEC 的验证关系，推导指定线性模型的复电流均流条件。在 200 kHz、20 A RMS 铜导体工况下，640 股二维直束的束内电阻为 {{metric:coax_rac}} mΩ/轴向m，损耗为 {{metric:coax_bundle_loss}} W/轴向m，归一化复电流 RMS 偏差为 {{metric:coax_spread}}，表明共同端接下仍存在显著电流差异。纵向 PEEC 的已检查长度增量引起约 0.15%–0.30% 的电阻变化，互项积分变化约为 10⁻⁵ 量级，自项更小；5024 自由度末档电阻与等面积 Bessel 参照相差 0.044582%。结果为指定模型内的电流与损耗比较提供定量依据，真实换位束的端区、横向电流及实验性能仍需进一步验证。

title.zh-CN: 分层模型与可比较观测量。

report.zh-CN: 输运模型按物理对象与观测量分组：圆线内场用于解析与二维校准，多股二维场路求解共同端口下的复电流，纵向 PEEC 检验有限长度效应。连线标明内部场校准或等面积电阻参照。RT0 外场损耗与三维 A–φ 场诊断各自构成独立研究范围。
report.en: Transport models are grouped by physical object and observable: round-wire internal fields support analytical and two-dimensional calibration, multistrand field–circuit models resolve common-terminal phasor currents, and longitudinal PEEC examines finite-length effects. Links identify internal-field calibration or equal-area resistance references. RT0 imposed-field loss and three-dimensional A–φ diagnostics occupy separate research scopes.

report.en: The copper conductor has diameter 2 mm and carries 20 A RMS at 200 kHz. Three grids and independent power integrals concern the same internal-field problem. Resistance is referenced to the internal Bessel solution of the same round wire. Power is evaluated by independent integration over the material region.

report.zh-CN: 各股沿途绝缘，在两端并联，逐股复电流由共同端电压及总电流约束求解。耦合矩阵 Z 与激励项 e 包含指定模型中的阻抗和场作用。受控回流承担反向总电流，并具有独立的端场。图中给出已知输入及待求复电流和电压。
report.en: Strands are insulated along their paths and connected in parallel at both ends; their phasor currents follow from the common voltage and total-current constraints. The coupling matrix Z and excitation term e contain the impedance and field contributions retained by the model. The controlled return carries the opposite total current and has its own terminal field. Known inputs and unknown currents and voltage are identified.

title.zh-CN: 纵向 PEEC 截面电流。

report.zh-CN: 方形细丝单元的复电流恢复 RMS 幅值。 代表模型含 5024 条纵向体积细丝，轴向长度 0.64 m。坐标和材料面积采用该档实际方形离散定义。
report.en: Complex currents in square volume filaments reconstruct the RMS magnitude. The representative model contains 5024 longitudinal volume filaments and has axial length 0.64 m. Coordinates and material areas follow that level’s actual square-cell discretization.

paper.zh-CN: 5024 个体积细丝、长度 0.64 m 的纵向 PEEC 模型。截面颜色由各方形单元的复电流恢复 RMS 电流密度，反映连续导体内部的趋肤分布。

title.zh-CN: 纵向 PEEC 长度敏感性。

report.zh-CN: 同一截面按保存的轴向长度比较单位长度电阻。 1264 自由度模型采用 0.16、0.32、0.64 m，5024 自由度复核末两档。积分参数在每个长度序列内固定。
report.en: Resistance per axial length is compared at archived lengths for the same cross-section. The 1264-degree-of-freedom model uses 0.16, 0.32, and 0.64 m, while 5024 degrees of freedom recheck the final two levels. Integration settings remain fixed within each length sequence.

paper.zh-CN: 1264 与 5024 自由度模型的长度敏感性。在各自固定的横截面上改变轴向长度，纵轴为按轴向长度归一化的交流电阻。两种离散各采用自身实际铜面积作解析参照。
paper.en: Resistance per axial length is compared at archived lengths for the same cross-section.

title.zh-CN: 640 股二维模型的网格敏感性。

report.zh-CN: 各试验按网格、回流和外域分别改变一个因素。 变化以相邻指定工况的电阻差归一化。网格、回流距离与外域大小各使用独立序列。
report.en: Mesh, return, and exterior tests each vary one factor. Variation is normalized from resistance differences between the specified adjacent cases. Mesh, return distance, and exterior size use separate sequences.

paper.zh-CN: 640 股二维共端模型的三档网格交流电阻。网格细化采用相同几何与激励；回流距离和外域敏感性另以独立单因素试验核查。
paper.en: Mesh, return, and exterior tests each vary one factor.

title.zh-CN: 纵向 PEEC 的单因素敏感性。

report.zh-CN: 互项阶数与自项精度各自进行单因素对照。 互项使用 q4、q6、q8，自项使用 10/8 与 12/10。比较保留同一截面及轴向长度。
report.en: Mutual order and self accuracy are compared in separate single-factor tests. Mutual settings are q4, q6, and q8; self settings are 10/8 and 12/10. Comparisons retain the same cross-section and axial length.

paper.zh-CN: 编号 1–3 为长度比较，4–7 为互项积分，8–9 为自项积分，10–11 为横向离散比较。积分项取电阻与复电流相对变化中的较大值，其余项显示电阻相对变化。各点的条件与数值见补充材料编号表；纵轴以百分数表示相对变化。
paper.en: Mutual order and self accuracy are compared in separate single-factor tests.

paper.en: Three grids and their metric targets are shown separately.

report.zh-CN: 矩阵与复电流相对差使用同一离散和积分设置。 相对差针对 1264 和 5024 自由度分别计算。水平参照为 10⁻¹⁰ 算法对照门槛。
report.en: Relative matrix and complex-current differences use identical discretization and integration. Relative differences are computed separately for 1264 and 5024 degrees of freedom. The horizontal reference is the 10⁻¹⁰ algorithm-comparison target.

paper.zh-CN: 1264 与 5024 自由度的 CPU/GPU 数值对照。两条曲线分别表示部分电感矩阵与复电流的相对差，每组采用相同几何、离散和积分设置。
paper.en: Relative matrix and complex-current differences use identical discretization and integration.

report.zh-CN: 曲线使用归档的时间及内存样本。 时间以对应运行的起点归一化。内存为可归属进程树的采样工作集。
report.en: Curves use archived time and memory samples. Time is measured from the start of each corresponding run. Memory is the sampled working set of the attributable process tree.

paper.zh-CN: 代表计算任务的进程树内存采样。横轴为相应任务开始后的时间，纵轴为采样时刻记录的内存；采样间隔内的瞬时峰值可能更高。
paper.en: Curves use archived time and memory samples.

report.zh-CN: 704 单元有效端口短测给出逐股幅值与相位。 电流采用实际 ±20 A 场解的端口记录。幅值与相位对应同一七股编号。
report.en: The valid 704-cell port short test provides strand magnitudes and phases. Currents use port records from the actual ±20 A field solution. Magnitudes and phases correspond to the same seven strand identities.

paper.zh-CN: Ansys 七股二维端口算例，采用 704 单元网格与实际 ±20 A 场解。图中按物理股线身份给出电流幅值，该数据支持本档端口及功率检查。
paper.en: The valid 704-cell port short test provides strand magnitudes and phases.

title.zh-CN: Ansys Student 能力与接口诊断。
title.en: Ansys Student capacity and interface diagnostics.

report.zh-CN: Ansys Student v252 的二维三角形、三维体单元与面单元上限分别为 2000、64000 和 8000，计算使用最多 4 核。并列分组表示各项许可限制。电流密度表达式 J 的接口探针与许可规模分别记录，实际求解状态见三维诊断。
report.en: Ansys Student v252 permits up to 2000 two-dimensional triangles, 64000 three-dimensional volume elements, and 8000 surface elements, with at most 4 CPU cores. Parallel groups identify the license limits. Probes of the current-density expression J are recorded separately from mesh capacity; actual solution status is reported in the three-dimensional diagnostics.
